added.question: Which bull, whose stone figure faces the inner sanctum of almost every Shiva temple, is the mount of the god Shiva?

Which saint was the founder of the Carthusian order, established in 1084 in the Chartreuse Mountains near Grenoble?

According to later legends and countless horror films, which metal is the one thing that can wound a werewolf?
In Norse mythology, from the body of which primordial giant did Odin and his brothers build the world?
